title: add a median() function
description: Add median(values) to stats.py returning the median of a list of numbers. Even-length lists average the two middle values. Raise ValueError on an empty list. Add tests for it in test_stats.py covering odd length, even length, and the empty case.

check.cmd: python3 -c "from stats import median; assert median([1,2,3,4])==2.5"

python3 -c "from stats import median
import sys
try:
 median([])
except ValueError:
 sys.exit(0)
sys.exit(1)"
